dashboard_labels.boundary_statement: This dashboard labels metrics as AI-system diagnostics and does not rank physics truth by workflow activity. Durable-quality rows are identity-bound advisory diagnostics; payload-ratio diagnostics and route-orbit warnings do not establish physics truth.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of eligible identity-bound before/after comparisons that remove at least one declared assumption without adding an unaccounted stronger assumption.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: A reduction is scoped to the declared comparison and does not prove the resulting theorem, candidate, or physical interpretation.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of a theorem's declared eligible application universe that is covered by explicit, hypothesis-preserving subsumption records.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Subsuming a shared coordinate does not reopen, adopt, or prove an exact historical family.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of eligible countermodels with a distinct immutable witness identity and a non-duplicate falsified assumption set.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Novelty is relative to the declared comparison corpus and is not a global no-go theorem or theory rejection.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of eligible immutable obstruction identities that are explicitly reused by a later tracked result or unified by a declared stronger scoped obstruction.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Reuse preserves the original obstruction scope and does not upgrade it into a global impossibility result.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of eligible objects receiving a provenance-qualified independent review that retain a non-promotional scoped result after all recorded findings are dispositioned.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Survival is not replication, adoption, proof authority, or a Gate Chair verdict.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of a prospectively declared benchmark universe with identity-bound results under one fixed assumption contract.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Breadth does not establish benchmark recovery, physical adequacy, or promotion.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of eligible failed, superseded, repaired, abandoned, or audit-finding events that remain visible as finalized immutable ledger records.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Visibility measures process memory, not scientific merit or Distance-to-GR progress.

durable_quality_metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Fraction of eligible attempt events whose sequence, payload hash, event hash, and predecessor binding validate.
durable_quality_metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Ledger integrity is project-control evidence only and does not make the recorded scientific content true.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Forbidden-conclusion summaries are counted as eligible overclaim-control surfaces; caught means no physics promotion was authorized.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: A high rate means better boundary control; it does not prove any physics claim.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: The current registries do not deterministically encode high-risk positive scoped-status omission events.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: This metric prevents pessimistic status collapse; it does not promote scoped evidence into adoption.
metric_rows.uncertainty_note: Needs a future extraction rule for accepted-scoped evidence omitted from summaries.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: This deterministic proxy counts obstruction records with IDs plus milestone, burden, or status context as locally scoped.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: A precise obstruction remains local unless a separate theorem and protected authority establish a stronger no-go result.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Repeated-burden streaks are process warnings only and do not change Distance-to-GR status.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: This is a process-warning metric; it is advisory unless a separate validator or policy makes a gate.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Exact immutable candidate IDs replace the former aggregate completion-stage proxy; an audit stage is counted only when bound to the same candidate identity hash.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Eligibility for audit is not audit survival, adoption, or matter-coupling derivation.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Exact candidate-keyed lineage counts only observed stress stages; the explicit graded-orbit stress absence is not inferred as a pass or failure.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Reaching stress means the candidate remains testable; it does not mean the candidate is true or adopted.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: The seeded stressed candidates all carry scoped obstruction dispositions; local freeze remains preserved and is not relabeled as survival adoption rejection or global no-go.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Survival is candidate-status only; it does not authorize canonical ontology, source-law, metric, or coupling adoption.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Gate-load signals are governance workload diagnostics, not Gate Chair scientific verdicts.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: Human authorization for a task is not a Gate Chair verdict unless the protected gate itself states that verdict.

metric_rows.diagnostic_interpretation: Payload balance compares mathematical payload items to process-only items; it is not proof authority.
metric_rows.interpretation_guardrail: This ratio is a productivity and balance signal; neither numerator nor denominator creates proof authority by itself.
